name: crew
description: A resident product team in Claude Code, run from its own pane with buttons and fields, no command needed: a PM splits your PRD into features and acceptance criteria, QA writes a test case for each, a UI/UX designer writes a design for each feature that you approve, a tech lead breaks the criteria into tasks and reviews the code, a full-stack agent builds the tasks on crew's own git branch and worktree, and crew runs your test command and maps the results to the test cases. Gaps and product questions come back to you in the pane. A heartbeat looks after the work every five minutes, a restart asks before going on, and token reminders go to Claude, which acts on usage only as you allow. The board is held to the PRD as it stands. Memory lives in the repo. Work in progress.
